name: routines_history
description: Lists the last runs of this workspace's routines and triggers, newest first, from the automation daemon's log: when it ran, its name, ok or failed, and the start of what it reported. Use it when the user asks whether a routine ran, what it found, or why it failed. It does not list the routines themselves or the proposals (that is routines_list). Returns one line per run; if there are none, say that nothing has run yet.

limit.description: How many runs to show, newest first, from 1 to 30 (e.g. 10).
